caption: ClinVar concordance (O2) per disease for three measures: HGVS recall at tier 1 (same GRCh38 allele), HGVS recall at tiers 1+2 (adding same-protein matches for papers with no cDNA), and tier-1 overlap, the share of extracted alleles present in ClinVar (not precision). Dots are percentages, lines Wilson 95% intervals as reported in the experimental log, and n/N is shown at the right of each panel. Rows are the registered six (run 2026-10-20; ClinVar release 2026-10-12, snapshot 2026-10-19), the extension five (D-52; snapshot 2026-11-14, ClinVar variant_summary of 09 Nov 2026) and Majeed syndrome (exploratory; snapshot 2026-11-15, same ClinVar release); the groups use different snapshots and are shown beside each other, not pooled. * Danon figures predate the D-43 re-normalization, which moved one placed Danon variant and unplaced another; O2 was not re-run. † Blau uses the D-53 NOD2 legacy-transcript fallback; under the registered rule its tier-1 recall was 4.5% (1/22), and 17 of its 19 remaining misses come from papers that give only protein changes in legacy numbering. Tier-1 recall in the registered six is low (10.1% to 35.0%) and the misses are concentrated in single papers. Majeed's recall (6.6%, 5/76) is low mainly because ClinVar cites some corpus papers for variants those papers do not report. Many denominators are small and the intervals wide. No threshold applies to O2 (D-03).
description: Three facets (HGVS recall tier 1; HGVS recall tiers 1+2; overlap tier 1, not precision) sharing a disease y-axis of 12 rows: registered six (blue #0072B2), extension five (orange #E69F00), Majeed exploratory (green #009E73), separated by thin rules. Dot-and-whisker with the log's Wilson 95% intervals (checked against n/N in plot.py), n/N at right, x 0-100%, no threshold line. Danon marked * (predates D-43), Blau marked † (D-53 fallback). Data from experimental_log.md §2.1.6, §2.2, §2.3.
